hints.title: Bottom-Up Layer Assignment
hints.text: Leaves are nodes with no children. Once leaves are removed, their parent nodes become the new leaves in the next iteration.

hints.title: Node Height from Bottom
hints.text: The round in which a node is removed is equal to its height counted from the bottom leaves upward.

hints.title: Post-Order Depth Calculation
hints.text: Compute node height as 1 plus the maximum height of its children, with null children having height -1. Place the node value into the result bucket at index equal to its height.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Single post-order traversal assigns each node to its leaf-level bucket.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating leaf removal and pruning takes O(N^2) in skewed binary trees.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bucketing values by calculated height collects layers in one pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Realize that removal iteration equals node height from bottom.
